assessments.rationale: Existing selected client companions remain inactive. Scoped routine work needs no dispatch receipt, client configuration or model attestation; no new client/model authority is inferred.
Preserve selected provisioning and unchanged-source local pre-dispatch redirect protection. No host inventory, provisioning plan or OS operation is needed for this governance task.
Preserve selected adapters and current bounded-response/origin overrides. Do not rediscover endpoints or start runtimes for routine edits.
The selected exact-plan executor remains optional; per-action plans/checkpoints are not required for ordinary repository edits. No invocation or replay is selected.

Adopt proportionality and one shared finite wave boundary. One implementation owner and a single independent semantic reviewer replace recurring coordination chains; optional structured operations retain their contracts.

DEC-2026-028 preserves established authority and forbids guessed new sequences. This dated extension uses the stable catalog feature reference, not a new final sequence; no allocation service is adopted.

Individual public SQL/API approvals, concrete-operation privacy gates and Lab ownership remain stricter safety boundaries. Their enforcement does not require repeated reading or redundant permission questions for this explicitly authorized process cleanup.

User explicitly selects effective scoped analysis reuse, local deterministic mechanical checks and bounded reviews. Without measured token telemetry the shared scope/agent default is one task/PR, one owner, one reviewer and at most one changed-input follow-up. Unknown discovery disables reuse; synthetic tests do not attest actual client settings.

DEC-2026-030 establishes that no central Artifact Registry is decided; DEC-2026-028 preserves existing references and forbids guessed allocation. No repository-native JSON Registration Authority or migration is selected, so registry-specific processing is not applicable to this task. Existing optional reference clients remain companions; no equivalent registry implementation is claimed.

Existing logical CI groups, retain-running mutating checks and exact final-head gates remain. No queue/admin change or unsafe cancellation is introduced; only stable metadata and necessary evidence are consumed once per qualified input.
Merge only the managed bridge and manifest core. Short scoped routing replaces broad repeated bootstrap while preserving all Toolbelt authority outside the block.

105 selected rows are manifest-hash verified; seven actual differences retain explicit semantic reasons. Source commit is the once-resolved pinned git archive identity, never inferred from the target repository.

Keep Foundation integrity separate from project semantics and runtime evidence. Run one impact-appropriate full governance audit with existing offline safeguards and the new reuse consumer scenarios; preserve required CI and independent semantic review.

Retain richer cost/quality taxonomy and optional router. Concrete routing remains relevant-operation only, with no provider research for every edit, no invented token/model values or new remote payload/configuration authority.

Keep DEC-2026-028 identity preservation, historical references and durable feature-key decision extensions. No new naming family or historical migration is proposed by the processing-only material change.

Equivalence is limited to the 1.20 proportional-processing delta: existing exact-head mandatory CI and no-admin/bypass rules already separate substantive failure from missing evidence. A failed or unknown check cannot become success. Outage policy remains installed, but no configured break-glass route or bypass actor is claimed; Ruleset administration is not authorized or needed.

Default ephemeral session reuse no longer requires optional persistent records. Preserve the selected persistent planner and its exact MISS/HIT binding when actually used; never infer analysis availability from a fingerprint or checkpoint.
Transfer only 105 selected manifest rows, preserving selected optional code, project-owned rule text, unchanged local safety overrides and licenses; no blanket directory transfer.

The per-edit full-read rule is an explicitly authorized target-internal efficiency conflict, not protected stronger governance. Replace it; preserve genuine privacy/license/SQL floors. Thin adapters have no separate substantive review requirements.

Evaluate all 21 candidates from the exact catalog, including already installed optional features. Record one classification each and retain separate recommendation/authorization boundaries; no unresolved adoption choice is hidden.

Event-driven small deltas and bounded wait handling replace long repeating heartbeat histories. Current continuation automation stays PAUSED; no token thresholds, rotation, successor session or new development wave is selected.
